override.title: Admin Yettwakkes
override.hint: Overrides ttwasekkren dima s tmagit-ik n tedbelt d ssebba - werǧin ad ssusmen.
override.cancelBookingHint: Asbeddi yesskanay-d aɛeqqa d tmehla-ines am wakken ttwabṭlen, yettarra-d lbaḍna n uxeddim i ucrik, yerna yettaǧǧa abennay ad yeɛreḍ aɛeqqa-a tikkelt niḍen.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Bṭel asekles-a? Tasmilt-is tettwabṭel ula d nettat. Aya yettwasmel s yisem-ik d ssebba-k.

detail.disputeOpen: Amciweṛ n tbaḍnit yeldi ɣef umeẓlu-a - amcic niḍen yenna-d d ayla-nsen. Yettwaqbel deg usebter n Yimenɣiyen.

cancellation.title: Asekles yettwabṭel
cancellation.hint: Ttwabṭlen l’booking d l’commission-is; tbaḍnit n uxeddim tuɣal-d sɣur ucrik yerna win yebnan yezmer ad d-yesbedd asenfar-a tikkelt niḍen.

disputes.title: Imenɣiyen n Tbaḍnit
disputes.hint: Amcicki i wumi yettwaqbel usekles-is d ayen yettwasnulfan, yezmer ad iqabel anwa i d bab n umeẓlu. Ḥess-d sin yidisan-nni yerna gzem-d lḥeqq.

detail.title: Amjadel {{id}}
detail.noteRequired: Aru-d tazmamt akken ad tgeḍ lḥeqq.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} yettḥadar amectari. Taluft tettwagdel ulac ayen nniḍen i ibeddlen.
detail.overturnEffect: Aḥareb n usnulfu n {{holder}} yekfa tura yerna amesni yettwasmel i {{partner}} d asekles amaynut.
